posts.caption_text: Rise and shine. First pour-overs of the day are hitting the counter now. Come say hi.
New seasonal cold brew is here: cinnamon horchata. Sweet, cold, dangerously easy to order two of.
Local artist spotlight: the prints on our south wall this month are from @atx.linework. Stop in and take a look.
Saturday morning regulars, you know the drill: patio's open, dog bowls are full, and the playlist is all soft rock this weekend.
We ran out of croissants by 9am again. Sorry to everyone who showed up late - we're doubling the batch starting next week.
Five years ago we opened with four tables and a secondhand espresso machine. Thank you, South Congress, for sticking with us.
Community board is filling up fast - if you've got a flyer for a local event, bring it by and we'll pin it up.
Iced oat lattes are outselling everything else this week. Not complaining, just noting it for the record.
Tuesday trivia night starts at 7. Bring a team, we've got a gift card on the line.
Thanks for another great week, Austin. See you at the counter.
